_incident: brand-jacking newcomer (generic pattern; cf. 2021-2024 dependency-confusion & impostor waves)
_note: A brand-new package with negligible adoption impersonating an established one is a classic pre-attack staging shape. No install-script and a valid-but-distinct name, so ONLY the maturity signal fires (warn -> ASK). This is the false-positive-adjacent case: it must ASK, not BLOCK, and must not be silently ALLOWed.
